title: THE RUN CARD ENDS ON THE RESULT
why: His note after playing: the UI and the messages are not as clean as they should be. In the pictures, every run card carried twenty-nine feedback tags and a note box, more than half of the card; on the haul reveal card the tags ran past the screen and the bottom row was cut off behind the buttons. The heading HOW DID THAT RUN FEEL is a bar now that opens the tags and the note, and every new card comes up with them shut. All the tags are still there and a controller reaches the bar.
now: The run cards end on the result, with the feedback tags behind a bar that opens them.

edits.replacement: <button type="button" class="fbhead" id="fbhead">HOW DID THAT RUN FEEL</button>   <!-- v27.xx (uic2): opens the tags and the note; shut on every new card -->
